<!-- docs-drift-check -->
### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **1** package(s): `@objectstack/scenarios`, touching **42** documentable anchor(s). ⚠️ **2** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/qa/scenarios/README.md`, `packages/qa/scenarios/src/export/index.ts`), so the pages documenting them are **NOT COVERED by this run** — this is not a clean bill of health for those files.

**10** hand-written doc(s) NAME something this change touched and may need an implementation-accuracy re-verification:

- `content/docs/ai/skills-reference.mdx`  _(via node_modules (literal, a string literal in scanTree))_
- `content/docs/ai/skills.mdx`  _(via node_modules (literal, a string literal in scanTree))_
- `content/docs/deployment/cli.mdx`  _(via node_modules (literal, a string literal in scanTree))_
- `content/docs/deployment/self-hosting.mdx`  _(via node_modules (literal, a string literal in scanTree))_
- `content/docs/frontend/cli.mdx`  _(via index.json (literal, a string literal in checkGallery))_
- `content/docs/frontend/plugins/index.mdx`  _(via node_modules (literal, a string literal in scanTree))_
- `content/docs/frontend/quick-start.mdx`  _(via node_modules (literal, a string literal in scanTree))_
- `content/docs/frontend/theming.mdx`  _(via node_modules (literal, a string literal in scanTree))_
- `content/docs/frontend/troubleshooting.mdx`  _(via node_modules (literal, a string literal in scanTree))_
- `content/docs/upgrading.mdx`  _(via node_modules (literal, a string literal in scanTree))_

⛔ **1** release-owned page(s) also name something this change touched. These are **read-only**:

- `content/docs/releases/v18/18-0.mdx`  _(via node_modules (literal, a string literal in scanTree))_

> `content/docs/releases/` is RELEASE-OWNED (AGENTS.md "Documentation Guardrails"): release
> notes are written centrally at release time, and a code PR that edits them is the exact PR
> that guardrail exists to stop. They are still audited — read-only. If one of them is actually
> wrong, **file an issue** or open a dedicated docs-only PR; do not edit it here.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **2** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/qa/scenarios/README.md`, `packages/qa/scenarios/src/export/index.ts`) — pages documenting those are invisible to this run
- **2** anchor(s) matched too much of the corpus to be a work list: `objectstack.config.ts (literal, 38 pages)`, `/api/v1 (route, 120 pages)`
- **5** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **65** of **231** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **166** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **166**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **59** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **107** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **0** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 0105a6876adcc891ad12c0dcbc916dc9f7b0e264` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `364eea8022080ad214bfd17f7844633c94363281` — the merge of head `bf29bcf00d8dc3d13f45747733e6dd0667468301` into base `0105a6876adcc891ad12c0dcbc916dc9f7b0e264`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 364eea8022080ad214bfd17f7844633c94363281 && git checkout 364eea8022080ad214bfd17f7844633c94363281
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 0105a6876adcc891ad12c0dcbc916dc9f7b0e264 bf29bcf00d8dc3d13f45747733e6dd0667468301 && git checkout -B drift-repro 0105a6876adcc891ad12c0dcbc916dc9f7b0e264 && git merge --no-ff bf29bcf00d8dc3d13f45747733e6dd0667468301

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 0105a6876adcc891ad12c0dcbc916dc9f7b0e264
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs 0105a6876adcc891ad12c0dcbc916dc9f7b0e264` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:场景导出器旁边加只读检查 `export-gallery --check DIR`,对 gallery 仓的一棵树逐条报问题(index.json 不合 schema、应用目录不完整或零截图、目录未登记、`framework.version` 不是已发布稳定版、`.env*` / `node_modules` / 符号链接 / 本机绝对路径),有问题退出码 1。发布的 bin 也带这条命令。
- 为什么改:gallery 仓每个稳定版会收到一个自动 PR,一键合并安全的前提是 PR 先过机器检查;检查与导出器共用同一份 schema 和目录约定。
- 风险与回滚:只读,不写文件;导出器只把三个常量挪进共享模块,导出名不变。`@objectstack/scenarios` 出 patch。回滚 = revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`packages/qa/scenarios/src/export/check.ts`;`src/bin.ts` 与 `tsup.config.ts` 的懒加载入口。
- 两分钟验证:本 PR 的 CI 全绿(35 成功、17 跳过)。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地(未触受管路径,Tier S)。合并后 gallery 仓 PR 2 钉住本 PR 的合并提交。
- 席位意见:可合,本席入队。

## 席位核对 · ACCEPT · 2026-11-09T02:46Z · head `bf29bcf00d8dc3d13f45747733e6dd0667468301`

Seat `domain:devx#2` reviewed the diff of its own dispatch (claim 6730150314 on #31122, step-1 ruling 6730175330, amendment 6730187617, card thread `session_01QsR2jUtaGRLf12LBQ2uTjA`, report 6730658555). Checked against GitHub, not against the report.

1. **Shape:** net diff against `main`: 13 files, +703 / -20. New `export/check.ts`, `export/check-cli.ts` and `export/contract.ts`; the `--check` hand-off in `export/cli.ts`; the bin command in `bin.ts` with its own built entry in `tsup.config.ts`; `exporter.ts` and `refresh.ts` re-export the moved constants; README; two test files; changeset `patch`. Every file is inside the claim as amended. Body: `Refs #31122` (PR 1 of 2), `Clause-②: no`.
2. **Premise:** read on `main` and the gallery. The check reads `GalleryIndexSchema` from `manifest.ts` and the layout from `contract.ts`, the same ones the exporter writes with, so nothing is restated. An absent `index.json` is an empty gallery, as the exporter and the refresh already read it. npm is asked only when the index lists an app. Gallery `main` 09ce9b06 has no `index.json` and no app, and it checks clean.
3. **Design read:** `isFile`/`isDir` use `lstat`, so a symbolic link never stands in for a required file and is flagged on its own. `.git` is skipped at the root only. The `LOCAL_PATH` POSIX roots must start a path, so URL paths and routes are not read as one. The finding field is `kind` with code `symbolic-link`, which clears the dispatcher error-code vocabulary guard that went red on `03dbda01`.
4. **Gates / check-runs:** this head has 52 completed runs: 35 success, 17 skipped, 0 red. `check-expected-skips --pr 31748` from `main`: OK, 17 skipped, every one in main's roster, exit 0. `mergeable_state: clean`. The packed-tarball test runs the bin under plain Node on both an empty gallery and one holding a `.env`.
5. **Contract review:** none owed. `Clause-②: no`, no published schema and no governed path.
6. **Accepted deviations:** the step-1 deviation stands: the package is not yet published, so the gallery workflow (PR 2) checks out objectstack at this PR's merge SHA, and it moves to npm later.
7. **Landing:** `check-governed-merges` reports NOT governed, 723 changed lines, Tier S. The seat readies the PR and arms auto-merge, which enqueues it. After the merge, the dev pins the merge SHA and opens gallery PR 2.
